title: Madrid, ‘The New Miami’: Mexican Oligarchy and Politicians Turn Spain into a Favorite Destination
author: Armando G. Tejeda
content:
_This article by Armando G. Tejeda originally appeared in the[September 6,
2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/09/06/politica/madrid-la-
nueva-miami-oligarquia-y-politicos-mexicanos-convierten-a-espana-en-destino-
preferido), Mexico's premier left-wing daily newspaper._

Madrid is already known as “**the new Miami** ,” being the center of
operations and gathering point of the Latin American oligarchy. The luxurious
Salamanca district is called “**the new Polanco** ,” because of its massive
presence of high-purchasing-power Mexicans.

The rent for an average apartment in those areas, with two or three bedrooms,
is usually between 2,500 and 4,000 euros (50,000 to 85,000 pesos), and for
sale they exceed one million euros (21 million pesos), even reaching 7 million
euros (150 million pesos).

In Madrid, former Mexican presidents Felipe Calderón Hinojosa, Enrique Peña
Nieto and Carlos Salinas de Gortari **enjoy a golden retirement**.

While the PAN member Calderón teaches at private universities and meets with
foundations and research centers linked to the right and the far right, Peña
Nieto and Salinas de Gortari keep a more discreet profile.

Peña Nieto was seen in late August in a tuxedo and wearing a kippah (Jewish
ritual head covering) at the wedding of the Israeli singer Omer Adam, in a
private castle in Portofino, Italy, alongside the businessman Avishai Neriah,
one of the promoters of the introduction of the **Pegasus spyware** in Mexico.

Salinas de Gortari is part of the International Council of the Teatro Real and
rubs shoulders with some of the city's largest fortunes, among them the
Asturian-born businessman Juan Antonio Pérez Simón, who founded his empire in
Mexico, alongside Carlos Slim, in Grupo Carso and Seguros Inbursa.

Gordillo was photographed at Barajas airport on August 11, smiling as she
posed for a follower, and later walking while another person carried her
suitcase. She was then seen at the Wellington hotel—where a room runs about
350 euros (7,500 pesos) per night and the suite exceeds 1,000 euros (21,000
pesos), while a tasting-menu meal costs between 120 and 250 euros (2,500 and
5,000 pesos)—as well as in the shops of Serrano street, called “**the Golden
Mile**.”

**Ricardo Monreal** , a Morena senator, was caught in Madrid in July 2025
while having breakfast at the luxurious Villa Magna hotel, before setting off
on the Camino de Santiago to celebrate his 40th wedding anniversary. His
defense was that he paid for the trip with his own money and not at the public
purse's expense.

In August, the governor of Campeche, also a Morena member, **Layda Sansores**
, was seen shopping at the famous exclusive store El Corte Inglés on Serrano
street in Madrid, and at the luxury footwear store Gianvito Rossi, where a
pair of shoes exceeds 1,000 euros (21,000 pesos).

In Avión, a small Galician town, the Vázquez Raña family has a mansion where
every summer some of Mexico's great fortunes gather, such as the businessmen
Carlos Slim Helú, Emilio Azcárraga Jean or the Servitje family.

Senator **Miguel Ángel Yunes Linares** —expelled from the PAN in 2024 for
voting in favor of the judicial reform promoted by Morena—was caught at
another European destination, the Italian island of Capri, while eating at a
luxurious beach club.

Social media also revealed the trip to Porto, Portugal, of **Alejandro “Alito”
Moreno** , leader of the PRI, where he sported a very valuable watch and gold
jewelry.
